title: How to file a car accident claim
text: To file a car accident claim, first make sure everyone is safe. Take photos of the damage and the road. Fill in the joint accident form with the other driver. Then tell Maple Mutual within 5 working days using the claims line or the website. Keep your claim number. We will contact you to book a repair estimate with an approved garage.

title: Documents needed for a car accident claim
text: For a car accident claim you need: the police report or joint accident form, photos of the damage, a copy of your driving licence, your vehicle registration, and a repair estimate from an approved garage.

title: How to file a home damage claim
text: For home damage such as a flood, a burst pipe or a storm, stop the water or power if it is safe. Take photos before you clean up. Do not throw away damaged items until we say so. Tell Maple Mutual as soon as you can. You will need photos, a repair estimate, proof that you own or rent the home, and a short description of what happened.

title: What your policy covers
text: Home cover includes fire, flood, storm damage, burst pipes and theft. Car cover includes accidents, theft and glass damage. Health cover refunds a share of doctor and hospital costs. Wear and tear, damage you cause on purpose, and items left in an unlocked car are not covered. Check your policy papers for your exact cover level.

title: Theft cover
text: Theft cover pays for items stolen from your home or car when there are signs of forced entry. File a report with the police first. Then send us the police report, a list of the stolen items with their values, and proof you owned them. Items left in an unlocked car are not covered.

title: Health claims and refunds
text: To get a refund for health costs, send your medical bills, the doctor's prescription, the hospital discharge summary if you stayed overnight, and your social security statement. Refunds are usually sent to your bank account.

title: How long does a claim take
text: Most simple claims are reviewed in about 10 working days. Claims that need an expert visit can take longer. A claim marked pending is waiting for us. A claim marked under review is being checked. A claim marked approved will be paid. A claim marked rejected has a reason, for example a missing police report, and you can send the missing paper and ask us to look again.

title: When and how claims are paid
text: When a claim is approved, the money is sent by bank transfer to the account on your policy. Payment usually takes 3 to 5 working days after approval. We do not pay by cash or gift cards. If you want to know where a payment is, give us your claim number.

title: Staying safe from scams
text: Maple Mutual will never ask for a code that was sent to your phone. We will never ask you to move all your money, to withdraw cash, or to keep a transaction secret. We cannot help anyone avoid bank alerts or checks. If someone asks you to do this, stop and talk to a person on our team. You can report a suspicious message on the claims line.

title: What is an excess in plain words
text: An excess is the part of a claim that you pay first. For example, if the excess is 150 euros and the repair costs 1000 euros, you pay 150 and Maple Mutual pays 850. A higher excess usually means a lower yearly price.

title: Talking to a person
text: You can ask to speak to a person at any time. We will hand you to a team member if you are upset, if your claim is larger than 10000 euros, if you need legal advice, or if something looks like a scam. The claims line is open on weekdays.

title: Changing or cancelling a policy
text: You can change your address, car or cover level at any time by contacting us. A new policy can be cancelled within 14 days at no cost. After that, cancelling may carry a small fee, and we will tell you the amount first.
